videos.title: GTA 6 Won't Start? Check These 3 Updates First 🌴 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 is out — if it won't launch, install PS5 system update 14.23 (required since Nov 17) and the second pre-launch patch 01.002.001 (~602 MB on PS5, ~1.6 GB on Xbox). Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes or confirmed a day-one patch.

Sources: Kotaku, Push Square, Android Authority, Tech Times

videos.title: Metacritic Had to Delete Fake GTA 6 Reviews 😳 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Before launch, fake user reviews dragged GTA 6's Metacritic user score to about 6.5. Metacritic removed them and temporarily blocked new user reviews, which usually open 36 hours after release.

Sources: VGC, VGTimes, LibertyCity.net
